subject: session date
fact: The session occurs in Menzoberranzan, under the matron's interest, with no ambiguity.
source_quote: Which is the complete answer, in Menzoberranzan. No ambiguity. No further explanation required. The matron's interest is the reason; the matron's interest is sufficient.

subject: drow spy size
fact: The drow spy has been reduced to the size of a child's toy, her voice pitched up into fury delivered from below knee-height.
source_quote: She shrank to about the size of a child's toy, her voice pitched up into something that was still clearly fury but now delivered from below knee-height.

subject: prayer beads power
fact: The prayer beads are at full power despite being shrunken, and may be more deadly or potent than before.
source_quote: Those prayer beads are at full power, even though they're shrunken, right? ... Yes — in fact, I believe they may be more deadly. ... They're more potent. Good to know.

subject: bag of holding interior
fact: The bag of holding contains a miniaturized drow spy, surveilled by Glabbagool, with air holes poked for ventilation and shielded from sunlight as mercy.
source_quote: We can put her in the bag of holding with Glabbagool, and he can just hold onto her. ... Poke holes. Let her breathe. ... This is mercy.

subject: velkynvelve prisoner journal
fact: The Velkynvelve Prisoner Journal is a masterpiece of interesting value, destined for study among other drow prison journal editions in Candlekeep's collection.
source_quote: This journal of the prisoners is a masterpiece of interesting value. I can't wait to study it carefully. It will go great with my other editions in drow prison journals.

subject: glabbagool's question
fact: Glabbagool, an ooze with no past or allegiances, has been granted one question at Candlekeep, the only one he will ever be allowed to ask.
source_quote: We give all five books. ... We also have a drow. ... I assigned Glabbagool to keep her under control. ... We gave all five books. ... Glabbagool, you get one question. Make it count.

subject: glabbagool's proliferating eyes
fact: Glabbagool produces many eyes as a demonstration of his true perception, revealing that his googly eyes are mere affectations to appear friendly.
source_quote: He started producing eyes. Many eyes. Proliferating eyes. ... I can actually see different ways. This is how ooze work. But I discovered that if you have these cute eyes, people take you more friendly.

subject: candlekeep entry protocol
fact: Candlekeep requires one book per group for access, but five books grant FaceTime with multiple avowed sages, making knowledge exchange a currency.
source_quote: The rules say that you must provide one book per group. But if you have come to ask more than one question and wish to intersect with many of the avowed ... providing more books will get you more FaceTime.

subject: drow spy's voice volume
fact: The drow spy's voice, when imprisoned in the bag, emerges at the volume of an extremely annoyed insect.
source_quote: The spy's voice came out approximately at the volume of an extremely annoyed insect.

subject: daz's status as resource
fact: Daz is treated as a finite and valuable resource — the only person in the party who regards information as such — and is the subject of theoretical murder planning.
source_quote: I am categorically on record as being the only person in this party who treats information as a finite and valuable resource, and yet here I was, the subject of active theoretical murder planning while a restrained enemy watched us debate it.
